action_summary: Kept the v54 EEGNet checkpoint ensemble and pipeline, and changed only the inference aggregation. (1) Each model's output for each TTA view is now converted to a normalized probability distribution (sigmoid + renormalize) before averaging, instead of averaging logits and applying sigmoid once; probability-space averaging is less overconfident, which suits the KL divergence metric. (2) Added time-shift TTA views (+/-0.5 s with zero padding, plus their channel-flipped versions) on top of the existing flip TTA; zero padding matches the drop_value=0 temporal dropout used in training. (3) Fold checkpoints are now weighted by the inverse of their validation KL divergence parsed from the file names instead of uniformly. Final predictions are renormalized to sum to one and written to submission.csv in the same format.
